tool.name: DistancePerResidue
tool.description: : Wrapper of the Distance per residue analysis from MDDB workflow module.

param.name: input_topology_filepath
param.label: input PRMTOP,TOP,TPR,PSF file
param.help: Already processed topology file, with atoms matching the trajectory (e.g. the output of the input processing block). Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_structure_filepath
param.label: input CIF file
param.help: Already processed mmCIF structure file, with atoms matching the trajectory (e.g. the output of the input processing block). Format: [input].cif

param.name: input_trajectory_filepath
param.label: input XTC file
param.help: Already processed XTC trajectory file, with imaged and fitted coordinates (e.g. the output of the input processing block). Format: [input].xtc

param.name: input_inputs_filepath
param.label: input JSON,YAML,YML file
param.help: MDDB workflow inputs file, to set analysis parameters such as interactions, ligands or atom selections. Properties have priority over values in this file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_analysis_zip_path
param.label: output ZIP name
param.help: Zip file with the analysis summary (mda.dist_perres.json) and one results file per interaction Format: [output].zip

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: interactions
param.label: interactions
param.help: List of interactions to be analyzed. Each interaction is a dictionary with the fields name, agent_1, selection_1, agent_2, selection_2 and optionally distance_cutoff (Å). Selections are in VMD syntax. If not set, interactions in the inputs file are used. (Json)

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the MDDB workflow executable binary.
